label: Cosmic unity, internal/external…: The explanandum is the unity of the cosmos
term: cosmic unity, internal/external explanation and plausible mind in #87
definition: The explanandum is the unity of the cosmos. An explanatory demand, an internal parts-or-laws coverage fork, and exclusions of those candidates are separate commitments. An external explainer is assigned timelessness, immateriality and power, with mind only plausible.
note: No Sum2 whole, complete causal explanation, actual explanatory bearer, necessary individual, common unique source or God signature is selected. Requires-explanation versus actual explanation, internal/external exhaustiveness and adequacy remain open. Plausibly qualifies mind, not the other stated attributes.
